title: ファイアーエムブレム 封印の剣
sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. Snaps were studied outside it
The messages lie compressed in the cartridge; `find` found a caption on screen as Shift-JIS in work RAM, where the message shown is unpacked whole with the game's codes between
The pointer to the character being typed was found among the words pointing into that buffer, and a probe script followed it at each page's wait
Played from the map's narration through the bandits' talk, the talk in the castle and the talk at the camp: the route replayed from a state in one run with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 40 of 40 pictures, over 4 scenes; it said nothing on the 2 screens without text

The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture. The window and the bubbles scroll a row up between pages (4 of the 40 screens kept the row before), so the comparison held each screen to the rows it gained (compare's scrolls)
49 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed: 46 to the bar, 3 to check the final build check on the same route (the same 40 pages at the same frames)
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-AFEJ.lua: each page of the message window or speech bubble once it has typed out (or a press has shown it whole), the text since the page before. Not read: who speaks (a face, not a name), the menus and the map's windows, a choice's answers, the opening's narration that scrolls over the title.
